'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals William J. Savola III LS Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[William J. Savola III]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-L-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Insert your Chadrafan in my Asteroid
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
